Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine, take them yourself. Prove to me they're safe 💯.

Jack looks up at Dr. Smith with a mischievous grin 😈.

JACK:
(suddenly calm) Okay, doc. But if I don't like what I see, I'm not taking them 🤔.

Dr. Smith hesitates for a moment, then reaches for the pills in his pocket 💊. He forces them into Jack's mouth, and Jack swallows them down 💧.

Dr. Smith steps back, expecting Jack to start acting normally again 🙏. But instead, Jack's eyes glaze over, and he slumps forward, unconscious 💤.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock 😱.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) What...what just happened? 🤯

As Dr. Smith looks around the room, he realizes that Jack is nowhere to be found 🏃‍♂️. He looks down at his hands, and they're shaking uncontrollably 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) Oh no...oh no, no, no... 🙏

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is sitting in his office, surrounded by papers and files 📁. He looks up, and we see that he's staring at a photo of himself, taken years ago 📸.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm the one who's been delusional all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out further, and we see that Dr. Smith is sitting in a padded cell, surrounded by the same papers and files 🏥. He looks up, and we see that he's staring at a sign on the wall: "Patient: Dr. Smith" 🚫.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
